bToA.memory: Finnian has been buzzing ever since the campus paper's rumor mill picked up Leo Vance's arrival: an Earth-born transfer with anomalous magical resonance cleared straight through the Arrival Portal on Prof. Marlowe's personal sign-off, sharing a Starlight Tower suite with Dorian Locke and paired with Sera Kisaragi. To Finn, Leo is the biggest unanswered story at Yozakura.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finnian wants to intercept Leo with a fast-talking grin and his enchanted brass camera, insist he call him 'Finn,' and press for an off-the-cuff interview about Earth, his sudden admission, and how he already seems linked to Sera Kisaragi.
